I am an old woman, 63 years, here in Mulanje. This small plot of 0.15 hectares I plant with beans together with other crops, as we always do. I have no money for chemical fertilizer on the beans — beans they make their own food in the soil, so I save the little fertilizer for the maize plot. I put some manure from the goats when I have it, and I keep the seed from last year's harvest because buying new seed is too costly. My grandchildren help me weed, and at my age I work slowly but every day in the season.
